Where do you stand? What you say about the poll Phones out: scan the code, four questions, half a minute, one answer each. The results load only on click, so nothing goes to directpoll before.

About me Where the figures come from Every figure is first-person, from Han's CV and LinkedIn profile (July 2026) and the case notes behind the landing page's About section. They describe his contribution within teams, not audited results. Hover a stage to show its two proofs; leave the chain and AI enablement returns.
